normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only exists to feed the safeMint mint flow.
The recipient parameter only exists to feed the safeBatchMint loop.
The batch size parameter is only meaningful within safeBatchMint and its price check.
The recipient parameter only exists to feed the owner reserve mint.
The amount parameter only bounds the owner reserve mint loop.
The URI parameter is consumed directly by the owner-only reveal setter.
The reserve parameter is a direct argument of the owner-only reserve setter.
The cached balance local is used only to size the withdrawal transfers.
The destructured fee locals are used only to compute the withdrawal payout amounts.
The temporary metadata struct exists only inside the initialize construction loop.
